about.title: About DASH
about.p1: DASH (Digital Assistant for Smart & Honest Voting) helps you understand voting using clear language and large, touch-friendly controls.
about.p2: We do not replace official election websites or helplines. Always double-check dates and rules with official sources.

howToVote.title: How to vote — simple steps
howToVote.step1d: Enroll as a voter when you turn 18. You can apply online or at designated centres.
howToVote.step2d: Keep your EPIC number ready. You can find it on your voter ID card.
howToVote.step3d: Go to the booth printed on your slip or check the official voter portal.
howToVote.step4d: Show your ID to the polling officer and follow their instructions.
howToVote.step5d: Press the button next to your choice. Check the VVPAT slip if shown.
howToVote.step6d: After voting, you get an ink mark on your finger. Your vote is secret.
